title: Removal of directors.
bodyText: Section 421-14, relating to the removal of a director of an agricultural association, shall apply to associations formed under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§421C-17]  Removal of directors.  Section 421-14, relating to the removal of a director of an agricultural association, shall apply to associations formed under this chapter. [L 1982, c 97, pt of §2]
